calculation.description: For each tradable asset, take the negative trailing 3-day return. Activate the reversal only when cross-asset absolute-return dispersion is above its trailing 60-day median; demean cross-sectionally by the daily median. All inputs are lagged/completed at the decision date.

parameters.dispersion_statistic: cross-sectional median absolute deviation from daily median

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC and ICIR exceeded benchmark admission gates. Positive ICIR by subperiod: 2020-22 0.164549, 2023-24 0.121606, 2025-26 0.125519, 2026-07 onward 0.099599. Small 15-name cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
